integrity.proof_method: two-dimensional Fourier calculation and exact integration by parts

scientific_limitations: The general obstruction assumes a real twice-continuously-differentiable scalar profile with nonzero derivative at the antipodal distance; the full spectral sign classification is for the two-factor supremum-circle Laplace profile only. Equivalent results not indexed or inspected may exist. Numerical tests do not replace the proof.
title: Antipodal Fourier obstruction and exact Laplace spectrum for the supremum-circle torus
